Introduction

Leo is a Korean-Australian singer under GRID Entertaiment. He made his solo debut with the digital single "One Look" on August 17, 2023. He is a member of the project boy group ALPHA DRIVE ONE and the upcoming duo Leo & Sangwon and a former member of the pre-debut boy group Trainee A.

In 2025, he was revealed as a participant on the survival show Boys II Planet.
